meta.title: Inside Out
meta.tagline: The city is a book. Someone tore out the last page.
meta.intro: Hidden across Antwerp are traces — street art with a QR code or NFC tag. Scan one, prove you're really there, and a chapter of an unsolved case opens. Follow the clues to the final page.

challenge.question: Which famous painter stands on the statue in the middle of the square?
What is the figure on top of the fountain throwing?
challenge.hint: Antwerp's name is linked to it.

chapters.title: Chapter 1 — The First Page
chapters.intro: Placeholder intro. You weren't supposed to find this. Someone left it here anyway.
chapters.clue: Follow the river of people north. Where a giant's hand once flew, the next trace waits.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — The Giant's Hand
chapters.intro: Placeholder intro. The second trace. The letters are older than the paint around them.
chapters.clue: All traces now point to the museum. The final page is waiting there.

chapters.title: Finale — Inside Out
chapters.intro: Placeholder finale. The artwork was the last page all along.
chapters.clue: You solved the case. Claim your case card and share it.
